accepted.user_impact: order attempts are failing or have unreconciled outcomes fast enough to spend 2 percent of the 28-day budget in one hour
accepted.first_safe_action: freeze the latest risky release and reconcile unknown order outcomes before retrying writes
accepted.verification: the long and short windows both recover and sampled idempotency tokens reconcile
accepted.silence_policy: only a bounded incident silence with owner, reason, end time, and replacement observation

accepted.user_impact: sustained failed or unreconciled order attempts threaten 5 percent of the 28-day budget in six hours
accepted.first_safe_action: stop concurrent risky changes and segment failures by operation and release
accepted.verification: both burn windows recover and the responsible failure class is bounded

accepted.user_impact: the current error rate would consume the full budget over the objective window if sustained
accepted.first_safe_action: open an owned budget review and identify the largest eligible failure class
accepted.verification: ticket contains event counts, windows, release markers, and a due date
accepted.silence_policy: do not silence; deduplicate into the existing owned ticket

accepted.user_impact: acknowledged order state may be duplicated, cross-tenant, invalid, or missing
accepted.first_safe_action: freeze affected writes and preserve the reconciliation boundary before repair
accepted.verification: an independently reviewed reconciliation returns zero unexplained mismatches
accepted.missing_semantics: stale or missing reconciliation is a separate control failure
accepted.silence_policy: no routine silence; incident commander must record an alternative detector

accepted.user_impact: commit-correlated reads are missing the declared five-second visibility bound
accepted.first_safe_action: route the affected read-after-write journey to the primary path while preserving probe tokens
accepted.verification: new commit tokens become visible within five seconds on the declared path
accepted.missing_semantics: probe absence is unknown, never fresh
accepted.silence_policy: bounded incident silence with an active primary-path probe

accepted.user_impact: no present impact; forecast indicates an avoidable future saturation risk
accepted.first_safe_action: validate demand, headroom, retention, and query mix before changing capacity
accepted.verification: an owned plan restores the reviewed headroom horizon
accepted.missing_semantics: insufficient history produces no forecast and an evidence-quality ticket
accepted.silence_policy: deduplicate into a capacity plan; do not page

accepted.user_impact: service health is unknown because the observation or notification path cannot prove it is working
accepted.first_safe_action: establish an independent blackbox view before changing the monitored database
accepted.verification: a canary traverses probe, ingestion, rule evaluation, routing, and receipt
accepted.silence_policy: only with an independent replacement observation path

diagnostic_only.reason: WAL distance helps explain freshness but is neither user-visible staleness nor read-your-writes proof
diagnostic_only.page_when: only after a correlated freshness or imminent durability symptom

diagnostic_only.reason: a queue can be healthy backpressure while end-to-end latency remains within objective
diagnostic_only.page_when: only through the user-latency symptom or an independently defined overload invariant

diagnostic_only.reason: CPU utilization alone does not prove user harm

rejected.reason: one instance can be intentionally offline or safely covered by the service; the candidate supplies neither user impact nor a safe operator action
rejected.replacement: correlate endpoint and user-event symptoms; retain instance state on the topology dashboard
